description:
Compile an agent file into a deterministic, content-addressed brain.
    content = the file as a string; format = verdigraph_genome |
    claude_project_export | openai_assistant | prompt_list | auto.
    Returns brain_id, content_hash, node/edge counts, the 9-invariant
    firing report, and provenance. Identical bytes always produce the
    identical brain_id (VB1). include_document=true returns the full
    graph.

content.description: The agent file, as a string.
content.title: Content

format.description: verdigraph_genome, claude_project_export, openai_assistant, prompt_list or auto (default).
format.title: Format

include_document.description: Optional. Include the full compiled document. Default false.
include_document.title: Include Document

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

name: build_brain
title: Build brain
